label: Claude Sonnet 5.5

facts.value: Linda Marsh, the CFO, has the final word on approval.
Dispatch must know about a drifting unit within five minutes.
The driver app has to work with no signal.
Rachel wants a pilot with a few trucks on real routes before this goes to Linda.
Tom does not want a solution that needs a hole in the firewall.
Two years of data history matters because some customers ask for a full year of records.
A nightly file is fine to start for the routing software.
Rachel makes the recommendation, Tom signs off on security, and anything over $25,000 goes to Linda Marsh for approval.
Tom needs the security questionnaire filled out before anything gets installed.
Dock Wi-Fi is unreliable, and handhelds drop off it in the freezer half the time.
Tom already has six vendor portals with separate logins and chases down accounts every time someone leaves.
Half of the routes go through dead zones, and drivers can't wait around for service.
Rachel agreed to bring Linda to a call next week.
Rhyolite is also talking to Frostgauge, whose hardware came in about 30% cheaper.
Frostgauge has no driver app, which is a big deal for Rhyolite.
Tom will send the security questionnaire.
Priya will send a written pilot plan for the four trucks.
Rachel will bring Linda to a call, and Marcus will send the invite.
Pilot proposed on four trucks, installed at the yard overnight.
Pilot proposed to run for 30 days.
Overnight there is only one dispatcher.
Every truck is running right now, so trucks can't be pulled during the week.
The system doesn't touch the customer's network, and nothing on their side has to open a port.
Each truck gets a cellular gateway, and the warehouse gateway also uses cellular.
If a truck loses signal, the gateway stores readings and sends them when it reconnects.
Single sign-on is supported, so someone can be turned off in one place.
The customer owns the data, and it is stored in the United States.
Two years of history are kept by default.
The customer can export all of the data whenever they want.
It connects to the routing software by a nightly file or an API push to the stop record.
If nobody acknowledges an alert in five minutes, it goes to the next person on the list.
The driver app keeps logging without signal and syncs later.
Send the security questionnaire
Send a written pilot plan for the four trucks
Bring Linda to a call
Send the calendar invite for the call with Linda
